onboarding.title: Models
onboarding.subtitle: Voxt recognises speech with a model on this Mac and cleans up, translates and rewrites with a language model you set up. The model below is the best start, with others in Settings → Speech models.

speech.name: Qwen3-ASR 1.7B (8bit)
speech.about: The most accurate. Good with accents, dialects, names and several languages in one sentence. Shows the text as you speak.

footer.continue_tooltip: The speech model is still downloading. Later steps work once it is ready, or you can skip them.
